record.prompt_text:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: North Garden CH05 complete-chapter climax vertical sequence strip, ComicPanelPlans P048–P050
Primary request: Create one polished three-panel vertical webcomic strip in exact top-to-bottom story order. This is the chapter reversal and urgent cliffhanger: unexpected farmhouse smoke, realization, then a full-force run home.
Text-only ablation: no input images or reference pixels are supplied. Reconstruct the same two recurring fictional adults only from the written Soren and Sigrid continuity descriptions below; preserve mature proportions and the exact wardrobe.
Panel 1 — P048: no people; large distant ridge reveal of the farmhouse as the destination, its chimney now producing a fresh unmistakable smoke column under clearing sky; landscape geography and reversal are immediately readable; quiet upper-center field away from smoke.
Panel 2 — P049: dramatic medium-close Soren in foreground, mature face snapping from thought to alarm as he realizes they never lit the stove; farmhouse and smoke remain far beyond him; pale oatmeal coat, light-brown/dark-blond hair and map identify him; no text; quiet upper-left field.
Panel 3 — P050: large hero-wide directional rush toward the house; Sigrid breaks into a powerful uphill run in front, Soren follows with the folded map; mature athletic weight shifts, mud kick, boot traction, plaid wrap and oatmeal coat streaming with real cloth weight, urgent faces/silhouettes, house visibly ahead. Use grounded causal motion, not generic speed lines; quiet upper-right field.
Style/medium: flat graphic gouache fantasy-adventure webcomic; organize each panel as 4–6 broad poster-like value/color masses, with crisp contour hierarchy, matte gouache color blocks, strong negative space, and simplified silhouette backgrounds. Apply minimal localized texture only to the active clue or physical contact. Preserve expressive mature-adult faces, readable hands and props, causal action, and decisive silhouettes at 390-pixel phone width. No cloth weave, pore detail, pebble-by-pebble terrain, crosshatching, photorealism, cinematic depth-of-field, grayscale wash, or text of any kind: no embedded words, speech balloons, captions, labels, panel numbers, sound effects, logos, signatures, or watermark.
Flat-gouache density cadence: action and reveal anchors may use 5–6 broad masses plus one localized clue/contact texture; dialogue, deduction, travel, transition, and object-insert beats should use 4–5 broad masses and more negative space. Keep physical weight, mud, water, smoke, twine, leverage, and footfalls legible through shape, overlap, and pose—not surface noise.
Continuity — Soren: wavy light-brown/dark-blond swept-back hair, never black or bright blond; mature weathered angular face, light stubble; pale oatmeal work coat over muted blue-gray layers, dark trousers, wet boots; lean sturdy adult; carries folded map.
Continuity — Sigrid: dark-brown/near-black hair tied back in low bun/compact braid, never blond; mature angular face, dark brows, gray-blue eyes; dark blue-brown plaid wrap over gray-green practical layers, dark trousers, boots; athletic adult.
Composition: tall scroll, three discrete panels with clean gutters; large reveal, emotional close, largest action anchor. Protect quiet fields from smoke, face, people, hands, map, house, and essential silhouettes.
Constraints: exact cast per panel; fictional mature adults only; practical non-sexualized clothing; readable anatomy/hands/feet; no extra people visible at farmhouse; no child-coded features; no monsters, armor, magic, or undeclared weapons.
Text: no balloons, captions, labels, words, sound effects, panel numbers, logos, signatures, or watermark.
Cross-panel semantic gates (literal visual requirements): first new farmhouse chimney smoke of the chapter; stove was never lit before departure.
Flat-gouache arm invariant: exact specified cast; clearly mature fictional adults; stable Soren light-brown/dark-blond hair and oatmeal coat; stable Sigrid dark tied hair and plaid wrap; no child-coded features, monsters, armor, magic, undeclared weapons, speech balloons, captions, labels, panel numbers, sound effects, logos, signatures, or watermark.

limitations: The built-in tool exposed no model, provider, endpoint, provider request ID, usage, monetary cost, or deterministic seed.
The Codex tool-service execution ID is a provenance aid, not a provider request ID.
One stochastic pair and one changed input-instruction line cannot prove a general causal effect.
